title: Public Health Analytics-OS JSON Schema package

compatibility.additionalProperties: Existing definition, value and event contracts retain their 1.2 compatibility boundaries. Source monitoring adds strict snapshot and review-item contracts.
compatibility.legacyProgrammeTuples: Accepted for existing programme releases; new programme records should use named objects.
compatibility.validationBoundary: Structural validity does not imply source verification, semantic equivalence, computability, comparability, privacy clearance, domain review or custodian approval.
compatibility.backwardCompatibility: Packages 1.0.0 through 1.3.0 remain valid historical contracts. Package 1.4.0 adds source-faithful relative-change and programme-relative target semantics without invalidating prior record representations.
